**NOTE: This is a short competition with only two events. It is in series with [Twist Or Treat Seattle Mini A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeattleMiniA2026), which means that you may only sign up and compete in one of the two competitions.**

By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PNWCompTemplate2024#43238-please-read-competitor-responsibilities).
